 Actors Yoo Yeon-seok and Seo Hyun-jin, along with director Jo Young-min, attended a press conference for MBC's upcoming drama "The Perfect Lie" at MBC's Golden Mouse Hall in western Seoul on Wednesday.
 The psychological thriller, set to premiere on Oct. 30, follows a man and a woman who present opposing versions of the same memory, leading to a confrontation over what really happened.
 Check out the highlights from the event below.
